name: Faster sign-in offer
about: Every element of every Faster sign-in offer state. Facts measured from the built web app at 390 wide (density-independent points); tokens are the ones the applying CSS rule references. Schema: see AGENTS.md.

rule.name: offer_enable-failed
rule.pattern: offer.failed: Notice — Enrolment failed → stays on the offer: `offer.enableFailed` "Couldn't turn on faster sign-in." · Try again · Not now (D-61, D-65)
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

when.shows: The phone couldn't turn faster sign-in on.
when.next: “Couldn't turn on faster sign-in.” sits in the action bar above Try again; Not now still goes to Home.

rule.name: offer_enabling
rule.pattern: offer.enabling: L1 + OS prompt — One request at a time; primary shows progress
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

styles.exception: Documented exception: optical nudge — a spinner inside a label span sits on the text line; as a direct flex child (sign-in) it needs no nudge. Not a token on purpose; use the number as is.

when.shows: Turn on was tapped; the phone's prompt is open.
when.next: One request at a time; the button shows progress. Success goes to Home; a cancelled prompt comes back here with no message.

rule.name: offer_face-id
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

when.shows: First OTP sign-in on a phone with Face ID set up and faster sign-in off.
when.next: Turn on opens the phone's prompt, then Home. Not now goes to Home.

rule.name: offer_fingerprint
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

when.shows: First OTP sign-in on a phone with fingerprint set up and faster sign-in off.
when.next: Turn on opens the phone's prompt, then Home. Not now goes to Home; it can be turned on later in Profile.

rule.name: offer_offline
rule.pattern: offer.offline: Notice — `offer.offline` "You're offline. Check your connection." (D-66)
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

when.shows: Turn on was tapped with no internet connection.
when.next: “You're offline. Check your connection.” sits in the action bar; Turn on works again once online.

rule.name: offer_screen-lock
rule.pattern: offer.screen-lock: None — No fingerprint or face set up → offer uses the phone's screen lock (PIN / pattern / password) (D-64)
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

when.shows: First OTP sign-in on a phone with no fingerprint or face set up, but a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password).
when.next: The offer uses the screen lock; Turn on opens the phone's prompt, then Home. Not now goes to Home.

rule.name: offer_unavailable
rule.pattern: offer.unavailable: Notice — Phone answers "unavailable" at Turn on → stays on the offer, unchanged (tile and three points shown); warning notice in the bar, `alert-triangle`, `unlock.unavailable` "Faster sign-in isn't available on this phone right now."; the primary reads **Continue** (`offer.continue`) → Home; Not now hidden. Not enabled; recorded as offered; can be turned on later in Profile (D-93). Picture `offer_unavailable` approved (D-93 revised); in since the D-94 refresh
rule.appLogic: App logic: see the Faster sign-in offer rules in DECIDED.md

when.shows: The phone answered “unavailable” when Turn on was tapped.
when.next: The offer stays as it was with a warning in the bar; the button reads Continue and goes to Home. Not now is hidden; it can be turned on later in Profile.

rawValues.about: Typed sizes, colours or words that are not tokens / message keys: red in the viewer. Layout keywords, zeros and % are layout values (not flagged). Exceptions are documented on their source line, not red.

exceptions.reason: Documented exception: optical nudge — a spinner inside a label span sits on the text line; as a direct flex child (sign-in) it needs no nudge. Not a token on purpose; use the number as is.
